name: AutoHotkey Global Hotkeys
description: Exclusive-hotkey backend for AutoHotkey Linux on GNOME 49 Wayland. Thin broker only: registers accelerators through Meta.Display.grab_accelerator + Main.wm.allowKeybinding and relays Activations/Deactivations to AHK over the session bus. It never parses AHK, never executes commands and never forks.
